/* Runs one queued trace-material update and publishes completion.
   
   Algorithm:
   1. Validate the owning trace component and active trace state.
   2. Call ULuxTraceComponent_ApplyTraceMaterialParameters with the embedded shared-reference pair.
   3. Set the plain fComplete byte at +0x20 on every path.
   
   Parameters:
     pWorkItem: exact 0x28-byte FLuxTraceMaterialUpdateWorkItem owned by the tick function until
   completion.
   
   Returns:
     void.
   
   Concurrency:
     The producer retains the shared-reference controller before queue submission, busy-waits on the
   plain completion byte, and releases the reference only after the queued and inline paths have
   converged.
   
   Rollback Relevance:
     The worker performs retained trace-state mutation as well as downstream material writes. It
   must run during rollback resimulation.
   
   Source:
     SoulcaliburVI.exe 0x1408CF1A0. */

void ProcessLuxTraceMaterialUpdateWorkItem(FLuxTraceMaterialUpdateWorkItem *pWorkItem)

{
  if ((pWorkItem->pTraceComponent != (ULuxTraceComponent_RollbackPartial *)0x0) &&
     (pWorkItem->pTraceState != (FLuxActiveTraceRuntimeState *)0x0)) {
    ULuxTraceComponent_ApplyTraceMaterialParameters
              (pWorkItem->pTraceComponent,(FLuxActiveTraceSharedRef *)&pWorkItem->pTraceState);
  }
  pWorkItem->fComplete = true;
  return;
}
